features: Live radio, podcasts and LibriVox audiobooks from OndaCast in one calm player
In the top bar: artwork and what is playing, with play/pause, even while the window is minimized
Ask Sprout to play a show, an episode, a book or a station; he tells you about new episodes
Shelf widgets: Now playing, New episodes, Continue listening and Favorite stations
Podcast categories, Up next that fills itself, playlists, repeat and shuffle
Resume anywhere, chapter progress, bookmarks with notes, sleep timer and keyboard shortcuts
requirements: A Tend panel that provides the ondacast capability
Tend Notes installed with a notebook, to save clips (optional)
release_notes: 1.7.1: Now called Tend Player (formerly TEND Media); the app id and your library are unchanged. The icon now follows your theme.
